what: Parser plan says the awk END block emits via emit_kv
scenario_or_breakage: awk cannot call the shell emit_kv function, and direct /dev/fd/3 output breaks when LARCH_QUIET_DISABLE=1, so parser harnesses or tally command substitutions can receive no PARSED_* records
suggested_fix: Have awk print raw parsed fields to stdout for the Bash wrapper to capture, then call emit_kv from Bash for all PARSED_* keys

what: Planned allowlist regex accepts invalid round directories
scenario_or_breakage: The stated contract rejects round-0 and leading-zero rounds, but ^round-[0-9]+/findings-classification\.tsv$ stages round-0 or round-01 and creates ambiguous committed log paths
suggested_fix: Use ^round-([1-9][0-9]*)/findings-classification\.tsv$ and add reject tests for round-0 and round-01

what: Nested symlinks are silently ignored instead of rejected
scenario_or_breakage: A symlinked plan-review/round-1/findings-classification.tsv is excluded from find output and publish succeeds with the forensic artifact missing, conflicting with the strict reject-on-unexpected posture and proposed symlink-file rejection tests
suggested_fix: Fail publish when find sees any symlink under plan-review, or at minimum reject a symlink at an allowlisted relative path before staging

what: Sanitization command deletes tabs despite replacement contract
scenario_or_breakage: finding_reviewers like Cursor-Edge<TAB>Codex-Arch becomes Cursor-EdgeCodex-Arch, silently corrupting attribution while the harness expects tabs to become single spaces
suggested_fix: Implement one sanitizer that maps tab CR LF to spaces, optionally collapses repeated spaces, and use it for finding_reviewers and every vN_* field

what: Legacy --voter-files fallback relies on basename inference that is not the current contract
scenario_or_breakage: Existing callers and harnesses can pass arbitrary temp names such as v1.txt v2.txt v3.txt; vote tally still works, but the new classification TSV can leave v slots empty or misassigned during the transition
suggested_fix: For --voter-files, map the first three files positionally to Claude Codex Cursor unless a recognizable basename provides a stronger match, and test uninformative basenames

what: Parser contract does not say to ignore axis-looking tokens after the -- reason delimiter
scenario_or_breakage: A voter line with valid QUALITY=good followed by -- reason mentions QUALITY=no-fix can be misparsed by a simple position-agnostic token scan, corrupting the rating while the vote remains valid
suggested_fix: Parse only the segment between the anchored vote token and the first -- reason delimiter, and add a regression fixture with axis-like text in the reason
